$Comment: The Green wage: what a woodcutter just past the Green floor of Trim Work earns for one
order, once luck decides how the run actually went. Mmo_Sawmill_Trim_Pay routes here on level

alone; everything below reads the woodcutter's own Woodcutting luck through mmoskilltree:skill_stat with Param GatherYield@Woodcutting, the shared GatherYield plus Woodcutting's talents and kit counted whatever is in hand, since the wage is rolled when the order is collected (this is the mill's own trade, so Crafting luck is left out), so within this
tier a lucky run pays noticeably more than an unlucky one even though both workers stand at the
UNITS, the one trap worth knowing. GatherYield stores WHOLE-NUMBER
percent readings, not fractions: a fully claimed Woodcutting tree, the trophy hatchet in hand

and the woodcutter's kit worn together read somewhere near a hundred and sixty-six on it, which is what the top floor here is sized against; a server or pack that grants more gathering yield is respected here without moving that ceiling. Never swap it for the mmoskilltree:station_luck aggregate: that one returns a
FRACTION and would shift every floor by a factor of a hundred.
RANGES pay experience and essence drawn evenly between Amount/Count and their Max, decided once
per claim, which is what keeps two runs at the same floor from reading identically.
PULLS. Each floor's DropLists array names MMO_Station_Trim_Offcuts_T1 once per pull; listing the
same id twice rolls it twice, independently, so the count of entries IS the number of pulls.
